name: smart-rental-house-platform
description: Smart Rental House Management and Discovery Platform - Final Year Capstone Project

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'), cp=require('child_process'); if(fs.existsSync('frontend/package.json')){ cp.execSync('npm --prefix frontend run build', {stdio:'inherit'}); } else { cp.execSync('npx vite build', {stdio:'inherit'}); }"
scripts.test: npm run test:auth && npm run test:property && npm run test:lifecycle && npm run test:ai

author: Smart Rental Team
